title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to check whether External Document No./Vendor Invoice No. are unique or duplicated – Customization
summary: Developers can add customization to validate whether External Document No. and Vendor Invoice No. are unique or duplicated across both pre-posting and posted documents in Business Central, since the system does not perform this validation by default.
key_points: Business Central allows external document numbers on sales and purchase orders, invoices, and credit memos, but doesn't validate uniqueness by default.
A codeunit with event subscribers on Sales Header and Purchase Header tables can check for duplicate numbers in both draft and posted documents.
The solution includes a setup flag in Sales & Receivables Setup and Purchases & Payables Setup to optionally allow duplicates.
Validation can be scoped to specific document types or check across all documents as needed.

quotes.text: Business Central does not validate whether external document numbers are unique or duplicated.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the gap that requires custom solution.

quotes.text: If this kind of control is required, a small customization is necessary.
quotes.why_it_matters: Justifies the need for the codeunit-based approach.
